name: Wado Ichimonji
description: A pristine white-hilted katana rumoured to have been wielded by the world's greatest swordsman. Every swing carries the weight of an unspoken oath.

name: Tensa Zangetsu
description: The final form of a soul reaper's blade. Compact yet apocalyptic — its black edge tears through spiritual pressure as easily as flesh.

name: Kubikiribocho
description: A massive executioner's blade forged from chakra-imbued iron. Its supernatural edge drinks the vitality of those it cuts, restoring the wielder's own life force.

name: Nichirin Blade
description: A blade forged from scarlet Ore of the Sun, perpetually absorbing sunlight. Its crimson edge carries heat that no shadow can extinguish.

name: Lostvayne
description: A short Sacred Treasure of the Dragon Sin, capable of creating physical copies of its wielder. Every critical strike carries the fury of a thousand reflected battles.

name: Venuzdonoa
description: The demon sword that destroys concepts. A blade said to have shattered causality itself during the age of myths — its edge erases the very idea of defense.

name: Sovereign's Blade
description: The ceremonial blade of the Shadow Monarch, etched with the sigil of the Arise command. Each strike resonates through the shadow realm, occasionally summoning phantom soldiers to strike alongside it.

name: Bisento of Storms
description: A massive halberd reforged from the legendary Murakumogiri, crackling with seismic energy. Every heavy swing sends tremors through the earth that no armour can absorb.

name: Kyoka Suigetsu
description: A slender zanpakuto that bends all five senses of anyone who witnesses its release. Enemies struck by it find their perception of reality subtly, irreversibly altered.

name: Death Scythe
description: A cursed reaper's scythe that severs both flesh and spiritual energy. Each arc of its blade bleeds the enemy's mana into the wielder's own reserves.

name: One For All Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets reinforced with the concentrated legacy of eight generations of power. The stockpiled energy of countless heroes builds with every punch thrown.

name: Divine Protection Aegis
description: A blessed aegis carried by a knight born with over a hundred divine protections. Attacks that should land simply — don't.

name: Six Eyes Blindfold
description: A pitch-dark cloth blindfold once worn by the strongest sorcerer. Paradoxically, wearing it sharpens the senses beyond any eyes could achieve — and projects an automatic nullification field.

name: Baryon Mode Headband
description: A forehead protector saturated with nuclear fusion chakra — the final form of tailed-beast power. The energy it emits erodes the lifespan of all nearby enemies with each passing moment.

name: Dragon Sin Cuirass
description: The breastplate of the Dragon Sin of Wrath, forged in hellblaze and sealed with the mark of the Demon King's lineage. Strikes absorbed by it are returned with interest.

name: Ultra Ego Plate
description: Battle armour forged from the pride of a Saiyan prince who chose to embrace destruction rather than flee it. The more punishment it takes, the stronger the wearer becomes.

name: Shunpo Greaves
description: Greaves crafted from the spiritual pressure residue of a Soul Society captain's flash-step. The wearer's legs move before their mind decides to — slipping between attacks with uncanny instinct.

name: Gate of Babylon Core
description: The crystallised key mechanism at the heart of the treasury of kings. Attuned to its bearer's will, it tears open a golden gate each turn and hurls random Noble Phantasms at the enemy.

name: Armor of Existence
description: Plating hammered out of the fact that you exist. Whatever swings at you has to argue with reality first, and reality does not lose. Incoming damage is cut to a quarter of what it should have been.

name: Fists of Glory
description: Two gauntlets of compressed acclaim. They do not add power, they multiply the power you already brought. Every strike you land hits 15 percent harder.

name: Robe of the Dragons
description: Silk woven from dragon breath. No single blow can ever take more than a third of you, so the one tap finishers stop being finishers. Half of the Robe and Blade of the Dragons.

name: Blade of the Dragons
description: A sword with a dragon still awake inside it. It swings with wrath that is not entirely yours, and everything you hit takes 30 percent more. Half of the Robe and Blade of the Dragons.
